**Findings:** The release workflow (`.github/workflows/release.yml`) already uses `BINARY_NAME: fiz` to drive all artifact names (`fiz-linux-amd64`, `fiz-linux-arm64`, `fiz-darwin-amd64`, `fiz-darwin-arm64`). No literal `ddx-agent-` artifact names existed.

**What I added:** `release_artifact_names_test.go` — two Go tests in `package fizeau_test` at the repo root:
1. `TestReleaseWorkflowArtifactNamesFiz` — positively asserts `BINARY_NAME: fiz` is set in the release workflow
2. `TestReleaseWorkflowNoLegacyArtifactLiterals` — asserts no `ddx-agent-` literal appears as an artifact name

Both tests pass (exit 0), satisfying the AC: "A committed dry-run/static check verifies expected fiz artifact names and exits 0; no ddx-agent artifact literals remain."
